migration_tracks.name: core_contracts
migration_tracks.compatibility_adapter: private typed adapters at current public entry points
migration_tracks.completion_evidence: all cross-domain program, capability, request, result, and evidence types are Core-owned and pass serialization contracts
migration_tracks.retirement_condition: duplicate private contract definitions have no importers

migration_tracks.name: compiler_convergence
migration_tracks.compatibility_adapter: stable flagquantum.compiler package and bounded planning migration
migration_tracks.completion_evidence: one pipeline can be replaced without Runtime or user API changes
migration_tracks.retirement_condition: all supported compiler entry points delegate to the target facade and legacy internal imports reach zero

migration_tracks.name: simulation_extraction
migration_tracks.completion_evidence: a real engine and a contract fake pass the same conformance suite without Runtime consumer changes
migration_tracks.retirement_condition: numerical algorithm ownership under runtime/executors reaches zero

migration_tracks.name: platform_provider_convergence
migration_tracks.completion_evidence: two platform implementations pass capability, precision, communication, fallback, and replacement tests
migration_tracks.retirement_condition: no general-purpose module imports a concrete vendor runtime

migration_tracks.name: execution_provider_convergence
migration_tracks.completion_evidence: simulation and QPU or remote-service implementations pass one execution-result contract
migration_tracks.retirement_condition: backend selection and vendor result decoding exist only behind execution-provider contracts

migration_tracks.name: ecosystem_convergence
migration_tracks.completion_evidence: external objects are converted at the boundary and round-trip conformance tests pass
migration_tracks.retirement_condition: external framework objects no longer cross into Core, Compiler, Runtime, or Simulation

migration_tracks.name: agent_gateway_separation
migration_tracks.target_authority: protocol-neutral Agent package in FlagQuantum; gateways in external Compute Service
migration_tracks.completion_evidence: local SDK and Agent Services pass with the MCP SDK absent, and cross-repository contract tests pass
migration_tracks.retirement_condition: the main repository has no production MCP transport dependency
